<documents>
<document id="disputes-documents">
DocumentsˆthatˆhelpˆaˆdisputeˆTheˆrightˆdocumentsˆmakeˆaˆdisputeˆfasterˆandˆmoreˆlikelyˆtoˆsucceed.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆhelpsˆforˆeachˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆreceivedˆ-ˆOrderˆconfirmationˆshowingˆtheˆexpectedˆdeliveryˆdateˆ-ˆTrackingˆinformation,ˆifˆanyˆ-ˆYourˆmessagesˆtoˆtheˆmerchantˆaskingˆaboutˆtheˆdeliveryˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆasˆdescribedˆ-ˆTheˆproductˆlistingˆorˆdescriptionˆ-ˆPhotosˆofˆwhatˆyouˆreceivedˆ-ˆProofˆyouˆreturnedˆitˆorˆofferedˆto,ˆifˆtheˆmerchantˆaskedˆ##ˆCancelledˆsubscriptionˆstillˆchargedˆ-ˆTheˆcancellationˆconfirmation,ˆorˆaˆscreenshotˆofˆtheˆdateˆyouˆcancelledˆ-ˆTheˆmerchant'sˆcancellationˆterms,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆthemˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆUsuallyˆnothing.ˆJustˆconfirmˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorizeˆtheˆtransactionˆandˆthatˆyourˆcardˆisˆfrozenˆorˆreported.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆuploadˆOpenˆtheˆdisputeˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆtapˆAddˆdocuments.ˆPhotosˆandˆPDFsˆwork.ˆNeverˆsendˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆpasswordsˆasˆpartˆofˆaˆdispute.ˆWeˆdon'tˆneedˆthem.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="account-under-review">
AccountˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆSometimesˆweˆneedˆtoˆreviewˆanˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆtoˆconfirmˆidentityˆdetails,ˆcheckˆunusualˆactivity,ˆorˆmeetˆlegalˆrequirements.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆcanˆdoˆduringˆaˆreviewˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆdeposits.ˆDependingˆonˆtheˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcash,ˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆorderˆaˆnewˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆseeˆAˆbannerˆinˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆtheˆaccountˆisˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestricted,ˆandˆwhatˆweˆneedˆfromˆyou,ˆifˆanything.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆItˆdependsˆonˆtheˆreason.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆdocuments,ˆsendingˆthemˆquicklyˆisˆtheˆbestˆwayˆtoˆspeedˆthingsˆup.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcan'tˆliftˆaˆreviewˆorˆrestriction,ˆandˆoftenˆcan'tˆshareˆtheˆreason.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆmessageˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆrestrictionsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆbecauseˆofˆaˆnegativeˆbalance,ˆaddingˆmoneyˆliftsˆtheˆrestrictionˆonceˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="disputes-denied">
IfˆyourˆdisputeˆisˆdeniedˆSometimesˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdecidedˆagainstˆyou.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆthatˆmeans.ˆ##ˆWhyˆdisputesˆareˆdeniedˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆshowedˆyouˆmadeˆorˆauthorizedˆtheˆpurchase,ˆforˆexampleˆwithˆdeliveryˆproofˆsignedˆatˆyourˆaddress.ˆ-ˆTheˆdisputeˆwasˆfiledˆafterˆitsˆwindowˆclosed.ˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆalreadyˆrefundedˆyou.ˆ-ˆTheˆissueˆisn'tˆcovered,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆpriceˆyouˆagreedˆtoˆandˆlaterˆchangedˆyourˆmindˆabout.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆWeˆsendˆyouˆaˆwrittenˆexplanationˆfirst.ˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆback.ˆIfˆthatˆleavesˆyourˆbalanceˆnegative,ˆaddˆmoneyˆsoˆyourˆaccountˆisn'tˆrestricted.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆappeal?ˆYes,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆnewˆinformation.ˆReplyˆtoˆtheˆdecisionˆmessageˆwithˆtheˆnewˆdocumentsˆandˆwe'llˆreviewˆitˆagain.ˆWeˆcan'tˆreopenˆaˆdisputeˆjustˆbecauseˆyouˆdisagreeˆwithˆtheˆoutcome.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆSeeˆ"Negativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdispute"ˆforˆhowˆrepaymentˆworks.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
